reauth_confirm.title: Update LAN check code
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current LAN check code shown on your printer.

user.title: Connect to your Creator 5
user.description: Enable LAN mode and enter the private IPv4 address, serial number and LAN check code from your printer. This integration reads status and can switch the chamber light. No print controls are provided.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read printer status. Check address, firmware and network access.
error.invalid_auth: Check serial number, LAN check code and LAN mode.
error.invalid_config: Enter a private IPv4 address and nonempty credentials.

init.title: Monitoring and material assignments
init.description: These settings only affect Home Assistant. Slot mappings are user configured, not detected; update them when the physical assignment changes. Camera video connects only when requested.

data.camera_stream_url: Camera MJPEG URL (optional; otherwise use printer report)

error.invalid_options: Use an interval of 5–300 seconds, slot numbers 0–4 and short plain-text notes. Camera URL must use this printer’s IP, port 8080 and /?action=stream.
